empty.title: No page open
empty.noSessionHint: Open a session to use the browser.
empty.hint: Pages {{agent}} opens show here too, with the sign-ins you make or bring into this browser.

signIns.title: Bring sign-ins from another browser
signIns.lead: Kettu copies the sign-ins of the sites you pick into its own browser, so agents find you signed in there. Passwords, passkeys, history and bookmarks stay where they are.

unavailable.safari: Safari keeps its sign-ins where only apps with Full Disk Access can read them. Not supported yet.
unavailable.windowsLocked: {{browser}} locks its sign-ins to itself on Windows, so no other app can read them.
unavailable.linuxKeyring: {{browser}} keeps the key to its sign-ins in the system keyring, which Kettu can’t read.

signIns.noBrowsers: No browser with sign-ins was found on this computer.
signIns.nothingUnlocked: Nothing is unlocked until you pick the sites.
signIns.noSites: {{browser}} has no sign-ins in this profile.

groups.held: Left out unless you pick them
groups.heldNote: Email, banking and sites that sign you in to others

kind.sso: Signs you in to other sites

signIns.google: {{browser}} ties Google’s sign-in to this computer. Sign in to Google in Kettu’s browser once instead.
signIns.pickedKeychain: {{picked}} of {{total}} sites · macOS asks for your password next

unlock.title: macOS asks for your Mac password
unlock.body: Enter it in the window macOS shows and choose Allow. Kettu reads the sign-ins of the {{count}} sites you picked and nothing else.
unlock.bodyOne: Enter it in the window macOS shows and choose Allow. Only this site’s sign-in is read.
unlock.always: Always Allow would let any app on this Mac read {{browser}}’s sign-ins without asking.

prompt.label: The window macOS shows
prompt.ask: {{app}} wants to use your confidential information stored in “{{item}}” in your keychain.
prompt.password: To allow this, enter the “login” keychain password.

done.body: Agents find you signed in on them in Kettu’s browser. If a site signs you out later, sign in there or bring it again.
done.note: Bring more any time from Settings › Browser.
done.noneBody: {{browser}} has no sign-in for these sites any more. Sign in to them in Kettu’s browser.

denied.title: {{browser}}’s sign-ins stayed locked
denied.body: macOS was told Deny, so nothing came over. Try again and choose Allow, or sign in to each site in Kettu’s browser.

failed.title: Couldn’t read {{browser}}’s sign-ins
failed.body: Nothing came over. Try again, or sign in to the site in Kettu’s browser.

signIns.chipTitle: Use the sign-in for {{site}} from {{browser}}’s {{profile}} profile
signIns.offerNote: Pick the sites. Passwords stay in {{browser}}.

notice.downloadBlocked: Downloads are blocked in Kettu's browser
notice.evicted: This page was closed to save memory
